text.en:
Executive Order No. 222 dated June 30, 2003, transferring
PACE to NAPC is hereby revoked.
All Executive issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or any
part thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby
revoked, amended or modified accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 31st day of March in the year of Our
Lord, Two Thousand and Four.
By the President:
lither slan
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
